name: combat-reviews-flagship-01
objective: Make combat-sports fans understand that Combat Reviews brings events, fight cards, predictions, the leaderboard and discussion into one place, and get them to open it
targetAudience: Combat sports fans aged 18-34 who follow more than one promotion and argue about results after every card

productFacts.label: Coverage
productFacts.detail: Combat Reviews lists events across multiple combat-sports promotions in one app.

productFacts.label: Events screen
productFacts.detail: The events screen shows upcoming fights with predictions, full cards, venues, broadcasters and live countdowns, under the heading 'every card that matters'.

productFacts.label: Fight card
productFacts.detail: An event's fight card shows bout order, round counts and estimated start times, with the community prediction split shown per bout.

productFacts.label: Predictions
productFacts.detail: Points are earned from correct predictions in the CombatReviews Challenge, ranked on a leaderboard by prediction accuracy.

productFacts.label: Not betting
productFacts.detail: The CombatReviews Challenge is skill, not betting. Combat Reviews is not a betting product and takes no stakes.

productFacts.label: Discussion
productFacts.detail: Each event carries a card-talk discussion region where fans talk about the card.

productFacts.label: How it is opened
productFacts.detail: Combat Reviews is reached on the web. There is no verified public App Store or Google Play listing, so no store badge and no download promise may appear.

keyMessages: Every card that matters, in one place
Predict before the first bell, then see where you rank
The discussion is part of the product, not an afterthought
mandatories: Show at least three real Combat Reviews product screens
End on NEVER MISS FIGHT NIGHT. and OPEN COMBAT REVIEWS
No storyboard pixels, no store badges, no invented data

cta.headline: NEVER MISS FIGHT NIGHT.
cta.subline: OPEN COMBAT REVIEWS · Every combat sport. One place.
